description: NEMSEER is a Python package for accessing and handling historical forecasts from the Australian Energy Market Operator for the National Electricity Market. It helps users obtain forecast data and organize it for comparisons with market or generation outcomes. The spatial coverage is the Australian NEM and the time span follows the forecast releases selected; the package is a client, not a new primary forecast dataset. The public repository, examples and documentation are GPL-3.0. Historical forecasts can support calibration of electricity dispatch, reserve or market-behaviour simulations under uncertainty. A caveat is that a forecast is information available before delivery, not the eventual physical outcome, and source-release conventions may change. The package may download source data during normal use, but this review obtained no forecast files. No catalogue record or first-review draft matched the software. The JOSS article and own repository were read without running the client. No directly related catalogue software record was established.
